meta.title: What is Ai Ki Do
meta.description: The meaning of the Japanese characters Ai (harmony), Ki (energy), and Do (path). The history of aikido, founder Morihei Ueshiba, and the philosophy of this martial art.

ai.name: AI
ai.meaning: Harmony, unification, coming together. It signifies being in accord with the world around you and with your partner.

ki.name: KI
ki.meaning: Energy, spirit, inner strength. The life energy that flows through all living things.

do.name: DO
do.meaning: Path, way. A lifelong path of personal growth and self-improvement.

p1: Aikido therefore means "The way of harmony with inner energy". It is a Japanese martial art based on the principle of non-resistance and redirection of the attacker's force.
p2: Aikido was created by Morihei Ueshiba (1883–1969), known as O-sensei (Great Teacher). He drew from traditional Japanese martial arts, primarily Daito-ryu Aiki-jujutsu, and combined them with his spiritual philosophy.
p3: Unlike many other martial arts, aikido does not seek to destroy the opponent. The goal is to control the situation so that no one is harmed – neither the defender nor the attacker.
